verdicts.rationale: Both George Lakoff, 1987, University of Chicago Press. b's title 'Women' is truncated at the first comma of 'Women, fire, and dangerous things'. Same book.
Both 'More than Cool Reason' (b adds subtitle 'A Field Guide to Poetic Metaphor' and coauthor Turner), 1989, University of Chicago Press. Same Lakoff & Turner book.
Both 'Philosophy in the Flesh' (b adds subtitle and coauthor Johnson), 1999, Basic Books. Same Lakoff & Johnson book.
Both 'Philosophy in the Flesh', Lakoff & Johnson, 1999, Basic Books. Same book, differing only in title fullness and author formatting.

a is 'Neues Organon I' (explicit volume I) while b is 'Neues Organon' with no volume marker. Lambert's Neues Organon is a multi-volume work; b could be the whole work, vol I, or a different volume. Risk of Part I vs full/other volume; cannot confidently merge.
'Groups, I' vs 'Groups, II' — explicitly Part I vs Part II with different issue numbers (5 vs 6), pages (559-605 vs 723-744), and DOIs. Two separate papers.
Both 'Foundations of (Cognitive) Grammar', Langacker, 1987, Stanford University Press. a title truncated at 'vol'; same volume-1 work.
a 'Foundations of Cognitive Grammar, vol' (truncated) vs b 'Foundations of cognitive grammar. Vol. 1, Theoretical prerequisites', Langacker, 1987, Stanford. Same volume-1 book.
Both 'Foundations of cognitive grammar' (b specifies Vol. 1, Theoretical prerequisites), Langacker, 1987, Stanford University Press. Same volume-1 book.

a 'Conceptualization, symbolization, and grammar' (incollection, 1998, Erlbaum) vs b 'Grammar and conceptualization' (book, 2000, Mouton de Gruyter). Different titles, different types, different publishers/years. Distinct works.
Both 'The Scope of the Conceptual' (a prefixed with chapter number '13.'), Margolis & Laurence, 2012, Oxford Handbook of Philosophy of Cognitive Science. Same chapter.

'The Perception of Causality in Infants' (1982, Perception 11(2), 173-186) vs 'Spatiotemporal Continuity and the Perception of Causality in Infants' (1984, Perception 13(3), 287-305). Different years, volumes, pages, and DOIs. Two distinct papers.
'Some perceptual limitations in talking about space' vs '...on talking about space', Levelt, 1984. in/on is a trivial variant; same chapter (b adds pages 323-358).
Same chapter as the b/c variants: 'Some perceptual limitations in/on talking about space', Levelt, 1984. Identical work.
b title 'Some perceptuallirnitations in talking about space' is an OCR corruption of 'perceptual limitations', Levelt, 1984. Same chapter.

Both Pylyshyn 'Things and Places', 2007, MIT Press, ISBN 9780262162456. Same book (a has the full subtitle).
Both Pylyshyn 'Things and Places', 2007, The MIT Press, ISBN 9780262162456. Same book.
